transcript: Speaker A: Guys, there's this networking event next Saturday. Should we go? Great for career growth. Speaker B: I am in. Let's register. Speaker C: Bhai, mujhe kuch kaam hai us din. [Brother, I have some work that day.] Speaker C (Narrator): Kaam nahi hai, darr hai. Networking event mein English mein baat karni padegi. Log pochenge, 'What do you do?' Main kya bolunga? 'Basically, main... actually...' Isliye mana kar diya. Opportunities chhod raha hoon kyunki English nahi aati. Meri dosti 10 saal purani hai in dono ke sath. School mein sab same the, college mein sab same the. Par college ke baad sab badal gaya. Sahil ne MNC join ki, English fluent ho gayi. Vivek MBA kiya, presentations deta hai. Aur main? Wahi hoon. Hindi mein sochta hoon, Hindi mein bolta hoon. Pehle farq nahi padta tha, par ab padta hai. Group mein plan banta hai English mein, main chup. Memes English mein, main emoji. Networking events, main mana kar deta hoon. Dheere dheere main group se bahar ho raha hoon. Physically nahi, par mentally. Ek raat Sahil ne pucha, 'Bro, you've been quiet lately. Everything okay?' Maine bola, 'Haan, sab theek hai.' Par Sahil samajh gaya. Bola, 'Amit, English ki wajah se hai na?' Main chup raha. Usne bola, 'Ek app hai, English Seekho. Try kar. Main bhi teri help karunga.' General English show khola. 'Hello se baat shuru karein' se start kiya. 1,65,000 log dekh chuke the. Hindi mein samjhaya tha. Roz ke 10 easy sentences dekha. Roz ki English, apne baare mein batao dekha. Apna introduction. Spoken English show mein pehli mulaqat wali English dekha. Networking event mein kaise baat karein. Tareef karna seekho dekha, compliment dena English mein. AI coach se roz 15 minute practice ki. 500 baar galat bola, 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi nahi boli, 'Tere dost fluent hain, tu nahi seekh payega.' Ek mahine baad Vivek ne bola, 'Networking event hai Saturday. Amit, tu chal raha?' Maine bola, 'Yeah, I'm in. Let's go.' Dono ne ek dusre ko dekha. Event mein gaya. Ek banda mila, main pucha, 'So, what do you do?' Maine bola, 'I work in digital marketing. I handle campaign strategy and performance analysis. Been doing it for about three years now.' Banda bola, 'That's interesting. We should connect on LinkedIn.' Ghar aake group mein likha, 'Guys, great event. Made some solid connections. Let's do this more often.' Sahil ne reply kiya, 'Bro, is that you?' Maine bola, 'Yeah bro, the new me.' English Seekho app download karo. General English show kholo. 'Hello se baat shuru karein' se start karo. AI coach se roz 15 minute practice karo. Doston ke group mein chup mat raho. Ek mahine mein wahi group mein bologe aur sab sunenge. Speaker D: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An animated story of Amit, who feels left out of his friend group and misses career opportunities due to his poor English skills. After a friend recommends the 'English Seekho' app, Amit practices daily with structured lessons and an AI coach. Within a month, he confidently attends a networking event, speaks fluent English, and successfully connects with industry professionals.
